## AI Agent & WebMCP Access
This site provides native WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) browser tools and JSON endpoints for autonomous browsing agents:
- **WebMCP Discovery:** {{ site.url }}/api/webmcp/index.json
- **Search Endpoint:** {{ site.url }}/search.json
- **Posts Feed:** {{ site.url }}/api/posts.json
- **Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD):** {{ site.url }}/.well-known/ard.json
- **Full Text LLM Index:** {{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt
- **Supported WebMCP Tools:**
  - `searchBlog`: Query technical articles, tutorials, and engineering notes
  - `getPost`: Retrieve clean structured article content and metadata
  - `getRecentPosts`: Retrieve latest published articles
  - `getAuthorBio`: Retrieve developer profile, stack, and social channels
  - `listSkills`: Retrieve catalog of published autonomous agent skills

## Agent Skills & Architecture Principles
- [Scaling Discipline](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-scaling-discipline): Architectural standards for predictable software under scale.
- [Diataxis Framework](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-diataxis-framework): Systematic documentation architecture for tutorials, guides, reference, and explanation.
- [Flow Check](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-flow-check): End-to-end seam verification ensuring features connect across clients and servers.
- [Flow Soundness](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-flow-soundness): Regression prevention locking in verified flows with dedicated tests.
- [Seam Contract](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-seam-contract): Single source of truth wire contracts preventing frontend and backend drift.
- [Safe Bug Fix](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-safe-bug-fix): Scoped, evidence-based debugging preventing regressions in shared code.
- [Meta-Cognitive Verification](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-meta-cognitive-verification): Rigorous multi-step verification and self-correction rules.
- [Root-Cause Discipline](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-root-cause-skills): Deep diagnosis protocols before applying codebase fixes.
- [Artifact Skills](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-artifact-skills): Polished HTML artifact production for explainers, plans, and reports.
- [Clean Project Export](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-clean-export-skills): Sanitized codebase packaging and distribution.
- [Laravel Skills](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-laravel-skills): Production Laravel standards, models, migrations, and patterns.
- [Filament PHP v5 Skills](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-filament-skills): Standards for Filament resources, relations, and forms.
- [Git Skills](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-git-skills): Clean git workflows, conventional commits, and atomic branching.
- [Deployment Skills](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-deployment-skills): Zero-downtime deployment practices and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
- [React & Next.js Skills](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-react-skills): Reactive state patterns, hooks, and clean components.
- [Design-First Frontend](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-frontend-first-skills): UI/UX design systems and responsive architecture.
- [Human Writing](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-human-writing): Authentic, clear technical documentation and communication.
- [Framework First](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-framework-first): Leveraging framework primitives before writing custom abstractions.
- [Local Source of Truth](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-local-source-of-truth): Single state authority patterns.
- [Blog Publishing](https://github.com/olakunlevpn/olakunlevpn-blog-publishing): Editorial and publication workflows.
